mguide_1: In order to receive payments from each order, you need to register at Multisafepay
mguide_2: 2. When your account was successfully synchronized, you need to click on the “Schedule new session” button
mguide_3: 3. In the opened modal window you need to select date and time of the planning session
mguide_4: 4. Now you can see your new scheduled session in the list of sessions below
